note: Fails if the window fallback changes: a base_fallback state must yield to the source windows that overlap the request (2018-02, the range, the spanning period), stand alone where none does (the 2018-04 gap), and never appear without a period. The February window's token is `2018-02`, a Rust-only fix: today's reader ends every February on the 29th and renders `2018-02-01..2018-02-28`.
